title: The Physical Impossibility of Reloading in the Mind of Someone Browsing
summary: A shark suspended in the browser's back/forward cache: leave and return and it revives intact; reload and it dies and is replaced.
mechanism: bfcache + Page Lifecycle freeze/resume + pageshow.persisted pause and restore a live canvas render, framed as a formaldehyde vitrine; reload resets the specimen.
references: Damien Hirst, The Physical Impossibility of Death in the Mind of Someone Living (1991)
Damien Hirst, the 2006 replacement of the decomposed original shark
Walter Benjamin, The Work of Art in the Age of Mechanical Reproduction (1935)
